note: CD19 CAR T cells (19-28z/JCAR015, brexucabtagene autoleucel) cleared ALL in mice and patients alike, while the CD19-DM4 ADC coltuximab ravtansine, near-universally active in xenografts, gave a 25% response rate in adults.
label: ALL (CD19 depleters)

engagement.judgement: 19-28z is the CAR in vadacabtagene leraleucel (JCAR015), so product_in_model true.
engagement.model: 19-28z CAR T cells in SCID-Beige mice with systemic NALM-6 ALL
engagement.note: 19-28z T cells (the JCAR015 construct) homed to and cleared systemic NALM-6 leukemia in mice before any patient was dosed.
engagement.short: Mice: CAR T cells clear CD19+ blasts
engagement.quote: Bioluminescent imaging of tumor in treated mice failed to identify a conserved site of tumor relapse, consistent with successful homing by tumor-specific T cells to systemic sites of tumor involvement.

engagement.magnitude_basis: clearance of CD19+ leukemic clones (mouse BLI vs patient deep-sequencing PCR)
engagement.judgement: Clearance of CD19+ cells counted as a direct readout of target engagement; the same patients feed efficacy through complete remission, a separate endpoint. Paired with the mouse paper, not stated.
engagement.model: 19-28z CAR T cells in SCID-Beige mice with systemic NALM-6 ALL
engagement.note: In five adults 19-28z T cells eliminated CD19+ malignant clones to MRD negativity, as they had cleared NALM-6 in mice.
engagement.quote: Nonetheless, in our studies, despite the steroid limited duration of 19-28z CAR modified T cells, CD19 targeted modified T cell persistence was sufficient to convert all patients with detectable disease to an MRD − status

dose.judgement: The repeat-dosing schedule was not carried into patients (single infusion after cyclophosphamide), so it was never tested rather than contradicted.
dose.model: 19-28z CAR T cells in SCID-Beige mice with systemic NALM-6 ALL

dose.confidence_note: FDA summary basis (MCL BLA) read; year opened at ZUMA-3 start (2016-03) as proxy.
dose.judgement: Same nonclinical package (shared with axicabtagene ciloleucel) assumed to support the ALL indication.
dose.model: Syngeneic murine anti-mouse-CD19 CAR T cells in lymphodepleted lymphoma-bearing mice

dose.quote: an in vivo study conducted using an analogous murine CAR construct recognizing the murine CD19 molecule demonstrated anti-tumor activity and increased survival in a lymphodepleted syngeneic adoptive transfer mouse model of CD19+ B cell lymphoma.

efficacy.model: 19-28z CAR T cells in SCID-Beige mice with systemic NALM-6 ALL
efficacy.note: 19-28z T cells eradicated systemic NALM-6 ALL in SCID-Beige mice.

efficacy.judgement: Prospective: the trial outcome was unknown when the xenograft data were published. Carol 2013 postdates CD19-directed ALL responses (CAR T, blinatumomab), but the track compares with coltuximab's own trial, not public until 2015, so entry 5 stays a prospective contra.
efficacy.model: Patient-derived ALL xenografts in NOD/SCID mice (PPTP)
efficacy.note: SAR3419 delayed progression in all 7 CD19+ ALL xenografts and gave objective responses in all but one.
efficacy.quote: SAR3419 significantly delayed the progression of 4 of 4 CD19(+) BCP-ALL and 3 of 3 MLL-ALL xenografts, induced objective responses in all but one xenograft but was ineffective against T-lineage ALL xenografts.

efficacy.population: Relapsed/refractory CD19+ B-ALL (adult trial; pediatric xenografts)
efficacy.confidence_note: Kantarjian 2016 abstract reports no CD19-level analysis; full text not checked.
efficacy.model: CD19 surface level across ALL xenografts as a response marker

efficacy.note: Single-arm phase 1 with no success bar; its primary endpoint was safety, and MRD-negative CR in 5/5 adults was a secondary readout.
efficacy.quote: All patients with persistent morphological disease or MRD(+) disease upon T cell infusion demonstrated rapid tumor eradication and achieved MRD(-) complete remissions as assessed by deep sequencing polymerase chain reaction.

patient_trials.quote: Complete remission was observed in 83% of the patients.

efficacy.judgement: Scored contra rather than partial: the primary ORR missed and the sponsor stopped for modest activity, against xenografts that responded almost uniformly.
efficacy.model: Patient-derived ALL xenografts in NOD/SCID mice (PPTP)
efficacy.note: Single-arm phase 1/2 monotherapy, primary endpoint ORR: 25.5% lasting 1.9 months, stopped early; xenografts predicted near-universal responses.
efficacy.quote: Coltuximab ravtansine was well tolerated but was associated with a low clinical response rate in patients with relapsed or refractory ALL.

patient_trials.quote: The study is stopped due to very modest activity compared to competitors

efficacy.confidence_note: Year is a proxy: ZUMA-3 start March 2016.

efficacy.judgement: The model was lymphoma, not ALL, and used a mouse surrogate CAR; scored on its track because FDA cited it as the in-vivo efficacy support.
efficacy.model: Syngeneic murine anti-mouse-CD19 CAR T cells in lymphodepleted lymphoma-bearing mice
efficacy.note: ZUMA-3 single-arm phase 2, primary endpoint overall CR/CRi: 71% after one KTE-X19 infusion, as the mouse predicted.
efficacy.quote: At the median follow-up of 16·4 months (13·8-19·6), 39 patients (71%; 95% CI 57-82, p<0·0001) had complete remission or complete remission with incomplete haematological recovery, with 31 (56%) patients reaching complete remission.

patient_trials.quote: Of 54 patients in the primary efficacy population, OCR rate was 65% (95% CI: 51, 77), and CR rate was 54% (95% CI: 40, 67).

safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level; no toxicity prediction stated in the abstract.

safety.model: 19-28z CAR T cells in SCID-Beige mice with systemic NALM-6 ALL

safety.quote: Bioluminescent imaging of tumor in treated mice failed to identify a conserved site of tumor relapse, consistent with successful homing by tumor-specific T cells to systemic sites of tumor involvement.

safety.population: Relapsed/refractory CD19+ B-ALL (adult trial; pediatric xenografts)
safety.confidence_note: Full text read; a small efficacy-lab tolerability study, not GLP toxicology (not public).

safety.magnitude_basis: tolerability at the dose taken forward
safety.population: Relapsed/refractory CD19+ B-ALL (adult trial; pediatric xenografts)

safety.model: Syngeneic murine anti-mouse-CD19 CAR T cells in lymphodepleted lymphoma-bearing mice

safety.quote: The USPI for brexu-cel has Warnings and Precautions for CRS, neurologic toxicity, HLH/MAS, serious infections, prolonged cytopenias, hypogammaglobulinemia, and secondary malignancies.

safety.note: Reproduced clinical CRS cytokines and tocilizumab-like rescue, but showed no neurotoxicity, which patients had.
